decisions.canonical_title: Identity Management for Agentic AI - OpenID pre-IIW workshop

decisions.next_action: Request or locate the official recording and resolve speaker timing before extracting statements.

decisions.canonical_title: Securing Non-Human Identities in the Age of AI Agents | CSA Summit 2025 at RSAC
decisions.reason: The Cloud Security Alliance page verifies the title, dates, and presenters, but the resource is account-gated and no accessible recording, embed, duration, transcript, or speaker timing was available. Page-copy statistics and vendor claims were not converted into spoken-source statements.
decisions.next_action: Obtain lawful access to the official recording and verify its duration and attribution.

decisions.canonical_title: Governing AI agents with Agent Identity Security

decisions.next_action: Human-review product-claim framing and confirm that no statement implies independent validation.
